add(openrouter): pin models to configured BYOK providers (#235)

add(openrouter): pin models to configured BYOK providers
- Pin matching OpenRouter models to the operator’s own provider key, avoiding unintended credit-billed routes.
- Preserve caller routing choices and privacy policies across fallback and streaming requests.
- Validate and document BYOK mapping, and explain HTTP 402 errors when routing metadata confirms non-BYOK billing.
